sources.note: Entry: 'Sácata is a dormant language of which only three words are known. Its speakers inhabited "the Marañon valley near Cujillo, province of Cutervo, and Yamón, province of Utcubamba, Amazonas" (Adelaar and Muysken 2004, 405).. classified with Candoshi (Rivet 1934; Loukotka 1968, 156) and with Arawakan (Torero 2002, 292), but "the factual basis is insufficient for either conclusion"'; no phonology, nothing on stress.
